title: M5 Architecture Boundary Map and Layering Invariants

canonical_core_execution.responsibilities: Defines universal, executor-neutral data models and deterministic dispatch mechanics. Validates package requirements against advertised capabilities. Reconciles task status and results without heuristic assumptions.

executor_adapter_protocol.responsibilities: Defines the standard boundary methods: capabilities(), validate_package(), dispatch(), status(), result(), cancel(), resume().
properties: no direct shell/git access outside adapter boundary

hermes_adapter_implementation.responsibilities: Translates canonical ExecutionPackage to Hermes-specific payload, maps canonical role to Hermes profile, translates Hermes task state to CanonicalTaskState, packages Hermes output into CanonicalResult.
boundary_rules: Hermes private types terminate at adapter boundary
No Hermes objects returned to Core caller

reference_fake_adapter.responsibilities: In-memory deterministic test double implementing ExecutorAdapter for contract and unit testing without host dependencies.

canonical_cli_projection.responsibilities: Machine adapter CLI. Parses CLI transport arguments, projects descriptor-derived flags, passes typed request to Unified Ingress / Core, formats CanonicalResult to stdout/json.

external_semantic_authority.responsibilities: Decides task purpose, semantic role, instruction content, and explicitly selects target executor adapter under ambiguity.

boundary_questions_answered.what_belongs_to_canonical_core: ExecutorCapabilities, ExecutionPackage, CanonicalTaskState, CanonicalResult, RoleMapping contract, ExecutorAdapter interface, ExecutorRegistry, Core Dispatcher, task reconciliation, execution error taxonomy.
boundary_questions_answered.what_belongs_to_executor_adapter: Translation of canonical execution package to executor-native format, querying native task status/result, translating native status to canonical state, error mapping.
boundary_questions_answered.what_belongs_only_to_hermes_adapter: Hermes profile names, Hermes worker management, Hermes CLI/host protocol payloads, Hermes-specific filesystem configuration.
boundary_questions_answered.what_belongs_to_cli_projection: Command syntax parsing, descriptor-derived argument attachment, calling Unified Ingress / Core execution entrypoint, formatting canonical results to stdout/json.
boundary_questions_answered.what_remains_external_semantic_input: Task intent, instruction text, semantic role choice, target executor selection under ambiguity, approval of high-impact operations.
